| **Shipping** | In stock, free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | Same |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method | Same |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | Same |
| **Specs / In box** | 40h battery, ANC + transparency, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, 254g; headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable | Same |

The only difference is the seller name itself.
